We use the chain rule in the form

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}\cdot \frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}.
$$

Let $u=2{x}^{2}+6x.$ Then $y=\sqrt{u}.$ Differentiating, we have

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{u}},
$$

and

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=4x+6.
$$

Multiplying the two together gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{1}{2\sqrt{u}}\cdot (4x+6) \\  & =\frac{2(2x+3)}{2\sqrt{2{x}^{2}+6x}} \\  & =\frac{2x+3}{\sqrt{2{x}^{2}+6x}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, substituting $x=3,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}|}_{x=3} & ={(\frac{2x+3}{\sqrt{2{x}^{2}+6x}})|}_{x=3} \\  & =\frac{4(3)+6}{2\sqrt{2(3{)}^{2}+6(3)}} \\  & =\frac{18}{2\sqrt{36}} \\  & =\frac{3}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "2cf444c8-3239-54ca-9516-8df227c41a5f" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "2cf444c8-3239-54ca-9516-8df227c41a5f" :question/answer-fields "099a5827-9c3f-5cf3-bff5-003f736749ad"] [:db/ensure "2cf444c8-3239-54ca-9516-8df227c41a5f" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186096842 :knowledge-point/questions "2cf444c8-3239-54ca-9516-8df227c41a5f"] [:db/add "7c11f32b-69c1-5fd0-bddb-c652f4dd99dc" :answer/id #uuid "7c11f32b-69c1-5fd0-bddb-c652f4dd99dc"] [:db/add "7c11f32b-69c1-5fd0-bddb-c652f4dd99dc" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "7c11f32b-69c1-5fd0-bddb-c652f4dd99dc" :answer/value "\frac{25}{12}"] [:db/ensure "7c11f32b-69c1-5fd0-bddb-c652f4dd99dc" :answer/validate] [:db/add "c3399efe-ec83-56d2-bfb3-9ba448fc95b4" :answer-field/id #uuid "c3399efe-ec83-56d2-bfb3-9ba448fc95b4"] [:db/add "c3399efe-ec83-56d2-bfb3-9ba448fc95b4" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "c3399efe-ec83-56d2-bfb3-9ba448fc95b4" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "c3399efe-ec83-56d2-bfb3-9ba448fc95b4" :answer-field/choices "7c11f32b-69c1-5fd0-bddb-c652f4dd99dc"] [:db/add "c3399efe-ec83-56d2-bfb3-9ba448fc95b4" :answer-field/correct "7c11f32b-69c1-5fd0-bddb-c652f4dd99dc"] [:db/ensure "c3399efe-ec83-56d2-bfb3-9ba448fc95b4" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "309f479d-646b-5563-8225-cb5faadfd4a1" :question/id #uuid "309f479d-646b-5563-8225-cb5faadfd4a1"] [:db/add "309f479d-646b-5563-8225-cb5faadfd4a1" :question/problem "The slope of the tangent to the curve $y=\sqrt{4{x}^{2}-7x}$ at the point where $x=4$ is{{field-1}}."] [:db/add "309f479d-646b-5563-8225-cb5faadfd4a1" :question/worked-solution "To find the slope at a given point, we have to find $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}$ at that point.

\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}\cdot \frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}.
$$

Let $u=4{x}^{2}-7x.$ Then $y=\sqrt{u}.$ Differentiating, we have

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{u}},

and

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=8x-7.
$$

Multiplying the two together gives

$$

:question/worked-solution "To find the slope at a given point, we have to find $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}$ at that point.

We use the chain rule in the form

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}\cdot \frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}.
$$

Let $u=37+7x.$ Then $y=\sqrt{u}.$ Differentiating, we have

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{u}}
$$

and

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=7.
$$

Multiplying the two together gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{1}{2\sqrt{u}}\cdot (7) \\  & =\frac{7}{2\sqrt{37+7x}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, substituting $x=-4,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}|}_{x=-4} & ={(\frac{7}{2\sqrt{37+7x}})|}_{x=-4} \\  & =\frac{7}{2\sqrt{37+7(-4)}} \\  & =\frac{7}{2\sqrt{9}} \\  & =\frac{7}{6}.\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "e8ccbb82-8efb-534c-acab-7f6468bd8bed" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "e8ccbb82-8efb-534c-acab-7f6468bd8bed" :question/answer-fields "c28412ef-227e-5ded-9964-e41d96174b86"] [:db/ensure "e8ccbb82-8efb-534c-acab-7f6468bd8bed" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186096842 :knowledge-point/questions "e8ccbb82-8efb-534c-acab-7f6468bd8bed"] [:db/add "255f9156-287e-5cc9-b8ed-eb31b15e83ce" :answer/id #uuid "255f9156-287e-5cc9-b8ed-eb31b15e83ce"] [:db/add "255f9156-287e-5cc9-b8ed-eb31b15e83ce" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "255f9156-287e-5cc9-b8ed-eb31b15e83ce" :answer/value "-\frac{7}{8}"] [:db/ensure "255f9156-287e-5cc9-b8ed-eb31b15e83ce" :answer/validate] [:db/add "b024a65a-2e57-571c-a34d-025276659956" :answer-field/id #uuid "b024a65a-2e57-571c-a34d-025276659956"] [:db/add "b024a65a-2e57-571c-a34d-025276659956" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "b024a65a-2e57-571c-a34d-025276659956" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "b024a65a-2e57-571c-a34d-025276659956" :answer-field/choices "255f9156-287e-5cc9-b8ed-eb31b15e83ce"] [:db/add "b024a65a-2e57-571c-a34d-025276659956" :answer-field/correct "255f9156-287e-5cc9-b8ed-eb31b15e83ce"] [:db/ensure "b024a65a-2e57-571c-a34d-025276659956" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "0a831727-2211-5532-89c4-e5a4ccb9ae4a" :question/id #uuid "0a831727-2211-5532-89c4-e5a4ccb9ae4a"] [:db/add "0a831727-2211-5532-89c4-e5a4ccb9ae4a" :question/problem "The slope of the tangent to the curve $y=\sqrt{-7x+16}$ at the point where $x=0$ is{{field-1}}."] [:db/add "0a831727-2211-5532-89c4-e5a4ccb9ae4a" :question/worked-solution "To find the slope at a given point, we have to find $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}$ at that point.

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}\cdot \frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}.
$$

Let $u=2{x}^{2}+6x.$ Then $y=\sqrt{u}.$ Differentiating, we have

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{u}},
$$

and

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=4x+6.
$$

Multiplying the two together gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{1}{2\sqrt{u}}\cdot (4x+6) \\  & =\frac{2(2x+3)}{2\sqrt{2{x}^{2}+6x}} \\  & =\frac{2x+3}{\sqrt{2{x}^{2}+6x}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, substituting $x=3,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}|}_{x=3} & ={(\frac{2x+3}{\sqrt{2{x}^{2}+6x}})|}_{x=3} \\  & =\frac{4(3)+6}{2\sqrt{2(3{)}^{2}+6(3)}} \\  & =\frac{18}{2\sqrt{36}} \\  & =\frac{3}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "2cf444c8-3239-54ca-9516-8df227c41a5f" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "2cf444c8-3239-54ca-9516-8df227c41a5f" :question/answer-fields "099a5827-9c3f-5cf3-bff5-003f736749ad"] [:db/ensure "2cf444c8-3239-54ca-9516-8df227c41a5f" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186096842 :knowledge-point/questions "2cf444c8-3239-54ca-9516-8df227c41a5f"] [:db/add "7c11f32b-69c1-5fd0-bddb-c652f4dd99dc" :answer/id #uuid "7c11f32b-69c1-5fd0-bddb-c652f4dd99dc"] [:db/add "7c11f32b-69c1-5fd0-bddb-c652f4dd99dc" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "7c11f32b-69c1-5fd0-bddb-c652f4dd99dc" :answer/value "\frac{25}{12}"] [:db/ensure "7c11f32b-69c1-5fd0-bddb-c652f4dd99dc" :answer/validate] [:db/add "c3399efe-ec83-56d2-bfb3-9ba448fc95b4" :answer-field/id #uuid "c3399efe-ec83-56d2-bfb3-9ba448fc95b4"] [:db/add "c3399efe-ec83-56d2-bfb3-9ba448fc95b4" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "c3399efe-ec83-56d2-bfb3-9ba448fc95b4" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "c3399efe-ec83-56d2-bfb3-9ba448fc95b4" :answer-field/choices "7c11f32b-69c1-5fd0-bddb-c652f4dd99dc"] [:db/add "c3399efe-ec83-56d2-bfb3-9ba448fc95b4" :answer-field/correct "7c11f32b-69c1-5fd0-bddb-c652f4dd99dc"] [:db/ensure "c3399efe-ec83-56d2-bfb3-9ba448fc95b4" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "309f479d-646b-5563-8225-cb5faadfd4a1" :question/id #uuid "309f479d-646b-5563-8225-cb5faadfd4a1"] [:db/add "309f479d-646b-5563-8225-cb5faadfd4a1" :question/problem "The slope of the tangent to the curve $y=\sqrt{4{x}^{2}-7x}$ at the point where $x=4$ is{{field-1}}."] [:db/add "309f479d-646b-5563-8225-cb5faadfd4a1" :question/worked-solution "To find the slope at a given point, we have to find $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}$ at that point.
